Hi Roshan,

I saw the RemindLink Show HN launch today. The product promise is clear: save a link and get reminded to read it.

I ran a quick public-page audit. Two concrete notes:

- No analytics artifact was visible in the fetched source, so launch traffic attribution is unproven from the page alone.

I saw the Riffn Show HN launch. The hands-free link to repo agents is easy to understand, and the public bridge is a strong credibility asset.

I ran a quick public-page audit.
